rule: D-LIB17-SIZE form (lib-17-card ruling 13), as the LIB-8R card's Do 1 asks: every number a card does not give, each Mistake's magnitude included, with its basis: a claim id, an approved plate's value used as a convention, a ruling, or a stated reason. PQ-H3 is never a basis. Each spec's exported SIZES equals its row here (tests/howto/lib8r-pilot-a2.test.ts).

M_SHRUG.basis: decision: D-PF2-SHRUG10 (LIB-PLATEFIX-2, PLATEFIX-2 PLAN RULED #395): sized to read, as the plank SAG precedent: a drawing value larger than a real range is allowed when no number appears in copy; side-on in the Mistake posture zoom it moves the shoulder 14.6 plate px toward the head at k 1 (pf3 R5/R11, pf4 R5); was 8 (LIB-PLATEFIX-1) and 5 (golden A dumbbell_lateral_raise's shrug, ref-src/plate.mjs:147); c3 'don't shrug'

PITCH.basis: decision: LIB-PLATEFIX-1, D-SPIKE-hinge camera pitch for the card's front view; plates panel pf1 (#385 6636073314 R1) read 40 as the trunk pitched at the viewer with a short hanging arm; rendered at 0, 12, 24 and 26 (0 and 12 read as standing upright); 26 keeps the back readable

BACK_OUT.basis: stated reason (LIB-PLATEFIX-2 R1, D-PF2-POSTZOOM): the posture zoom's straight dashed back reference sits 2 cm out of the back surface (sacrum -> upper back), so it runs beside the outline instead of on it; c2 'spine straight'

BACK_EXT.basis: stated reason (LIB-PLATEFIX-2 R1): the reference runs 15% of the sacrum -> upper-back length past each end, inside the zoom circle (H3.zoom:posture:ref); c2

POSTURE_R.basis: decision: LIB-PLATEFIX-2 plates panel pf4 R11 (#395: 'a larger circle, r about 125-130' card px): the side-profile posture zoom's radius, 68 plate px (148 card px), the smallest that holds the head, back, sacrum, buttock, hip and shoulder at k 1 with the 4 px inset; c2

SHRUG_K.basis: decision: LIB-PLATEFIX-2 pf5 R11 (#395 6653868933: 'the ringed region at about 2.7x, in the plate's raised-arm pose'): the Mistake zoom in the plate's own view; at 3 its ring (17.3 px) holds the shoulder joint marker, the cap top and the head side (pf3 R11); c3

SHRUG_PX.basis: decision: LIB-PLATEFIX-2 pf5 R5 (#395 6653868933: 'red dashed shoulder caps and the trap line raised about 8-12 px toward the head, on the main figure'): plate px along the trunk axis on screen (shoulders' midpoint -> head), drawn on top of the fill; c3

HEAD_SIDE.basis: stated reason: the head oval's half width at ear height, read from the engine's head outline (pf2 R5, #385 6637293768); where the trap line meets the head

HEAD_MEET.basis: stated reason: pf2 R5 'meets the head oval at about y 612' (card px): the trap line meets the engine's head outline 11.8 plate px above the head landmark; c3
